sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2728 of 2024
Applicant :- Naseem And Another

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Dheerendra Kumar Singh,Harish Tripathi,Indra Jeet Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants with the prayer to release them on anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.20 of 2023, under Sections 420, 120B, 406 I.P.C., Police Station Gola, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicants are innocent and they have falsely been implicated in the present case.
He further submits that false allegation is levelled that the applicants, for settlement of the offence, have taken some amount but there is no cogent piece of evidence thereof.

The applicants have no previous criminal history and they are law abiding citizen and they have acute apprehension of being arrested by the police, as such, they may be granted anticipatory bail which they will not misuse.
